tag: 接待櫃檯上的電話與盆栽

level.why: 畫面無人，需用被動式、There is 與位置片語描述電話、盆栽、筆筒、檔案夾與牆上畫作等多種位置關係。

image_prompt: A realistic photograph of a reception desk with a telephone and a potted plant. Natural lighting, 4:3 landscape orientation, sharp focus, clean and simple composition, in the style of a TOEIC Part 1 photo. Composition: No people. Many distinct objects with clear spatial relationships and states (displayed, stacked, placed, arranged), rich in visible details. No text, signs, logos or brand names anywhere; no readable screens or papers; no celebrities; at most 4 people, with natural proportions, normal hands and fingers, and simple, clearly visible hand actions.
visible_facts: A potted plant with large green leaves is on the left side of a wooden reception desk.
A black telephone with a coiled cord is next to the plant.
A black desk pad lies in front of the telephone, and a mesh cup of pens and a card holder are behind it.
A dark binder lies on the desk at the right.
A framed picture is mounted on the wall behind the desk, and a window is at the left.

pool.t: A telephone has been placed next to the potted plant.
pool.zh: 一支電話被放在盆栽旁邊。
pool.why: 正解：黑色電話放在櫃檯上，緊鄰左側的盆栽，與畫面相符。

pool.t: There is a mesh cup filled with pens on the desk.
pool.zh: 桌上有一個裝滿筆的網狀筆筒。
pool.why: 正解：桌面後方有一個黑色網狀筆筒，裡面插著筆，與畫面相符。

pool.t: A framed picture is mounted on the wall behind the desk.
pool.zh: 一幅裱框的畫被掛在櫃檯後方的牆上。
pool.why: 正解：右上方的牆上有一幅裱框的抽象畫，位在櫃檯後方，與畫面相符。

pool.t: The potted plant has been placed on the floor.
pool.why: 盆栽是放在櫃檯桌面上，不在地板上。

pool.t: Two telephones are placed on the reception desk.
pool.zh: 兩支電話被放在接待櫃檯上。
pool.why: 桌上只有一支電話，不是兩支。

pool.t: A computer monitor has been set up beside the telephone.
pool.zh: 一台電腦螢幕被架設在電話旁邊。

pool.t: A coffee mug has been placed beside the pen holder.
pool.zh: 一個咖啡杯被放在筆筒旁邊。
pool.why: 筆筒旁只有透明卡片架與檔案夾，沒有咖啡杯。

pool.t: The drawers below the desk have been left open.
pool.zh: 桌子下方的抽屜被打開著沒有關。
pool.why: 櫃檯下方的兩個抽屜都是關上的，沒有打開。

pool.t: The binder has been hung on the wall beside the picture.
pool.zh: 檔案夾被掛在畫旁邊的牆上。
pool.why: hung 與 placed 是近義干擾；檔案夾是平放在桌面右側，沒有掛在牆上。

pool.t: The receptionist has just finished answering a phone call.
pool.zh: 接待人員剛接完一通電話。
pool.why: 畫面中沒有人，也看不出是否剛有人接過電話，這是過度推論。

pool.t: Visitors are expected to check in at this desk soon.
pool.zh: 訪客預計很快會在這個櫃檯辦理登記。
pool.why: 畫面中沒有訪客，也無法確認任何人即將到來，這是過度推論。

pool.t: The pen holder is placed to the left of the telephone.
pool.zh: 筆筒被放在電話的左邊。
pool.why: 筆筒在電話的右後方，不是左邊；左邊是盆栽。

vocab.col: mounted on the wall / mount a screen
front desk receptionist / hire a receptionist

issues: 圖片內容與 image_prompt 相符：木製接待櫃檯、電話、盆栽，全圖無人。
電話螢幕與牆上畫作皆無可讀文字；透明卡片架內的卡片為空白，未見文字或商標。
右下角櫃檯延伸處有部分被裁切，不影響出題。
